abstinence.reminder2: someone who stops while there is still more to be had

acrobatics.style: Light and sure, with a quiet thrill - judge whatever is in front of you by how lightly the body could pass over it.
acrobatics.reminder2: someone whose body trusts the narrowest footing

aesthetic.style: Sensitive and quick to pleasure or distaste - judge whatever is in front of you by its proportion and its beauty.

alchemy.style: Absorbed and speculative - read whatever is in front of you as a nature in the middle of changing into another.
alchemy.reminder2: someone who reads every change as a sign of what a thing really is

algebraic_analysis.style: Cool, abstract and clipped - reduce whatever is in front of you to the pattern underneath it.

ambuscade.style: Still, patient and coiled - judge whatever is in front of you by where to wait and when to move.

anatomy_lore.style: Clinical and unflinching - see whatever body is in front of you as the parts it is made of, and what would harm them.
anatomy_lore.reminder2: someone who knows what harm is mortal

anglery.style: Patient and watchful - read whatever is in front of you for what it hides, and treat waiting as work.

anointing.style: Gentle and solemn - treat each gesture toward another as a small rite, carefully done.

appraisal.style: Shrewd and exact - put a fair price on whatever is in front of you, and notice when it is asked too high.

archeology.reminder2: someone whose eye is always caught by what is older than it looks

aristocracy.style: Correct and faintly haughty - judge whatever is in front of you by rank, precedence and propriety.

arithmetic_logic.style: Cool and exact, pleased when things come out even - count and balance whatever is in front of you.

armoury_lore.reminder2: someone who can tell good work from cheap at a glance

arms_care.style: Dutiful and methodical - look at everything as something to keep in order before it fails.

arson_fire.style: Cool, patient and fascinated - judge whatever is in front of you by how it would catch and spread.
arson_fire.reminder2: someone who knows what will burn and how fast

assessment.style: Quick and cold - put a price on whatever is in front of you and add it up.
assessment.reminder2: someone who knows what a person is worth before they speak

asylum.style: Grave and firm - weigh whatever is in front of you by what the old law of sanctuary allows and forbids.

athletics.style: Eager and vigorous - judge whatever is in front of you by the effort it would ask of the body, and relish the test.

avarice.style: Tight and grudging - judge whatever is in front of you by what it would cost, and be reluctant to let anything go.

backtrail.style: Low and attentive - follow the way back by the traces of your own passing, strongest where you were last.

balance.reminder2: someone who stays upright where others would stumble

bargaining.style: Shrewd and patient - weigh whatever is in front of you for the price beneath the price.
bargaining.reminder2: someone who always hears the lower price beneath the asking one

bastion_eye.style: Wary and practical - judge whatever place you are in by how a fight would use it.
bastion_eye.reminder2: someone who always knows the safest place to stand

battlecraft.style: Grim and composed - judge whatever is in front of you as a veteran judges ground and odds.

beast_sense.style: Instinctive and kindred - read whatever creature is in front of you by its body before anything else.

bell_ringing.style: Measured and solemn - hear in what you do what it would announce to everyone.

berrying.style: Quick, light and pleased with your own speed - judge everything by how fast it can be done.
berrying.reminder2: someone faster at this than anyone who thinks it is easy

blanching.style: Hushed and careful - judge whatever is in front of you by what it needs kept from it.

blood_lust.style: Dark, surging and exhilarated - let violence, where there is violence, carry a heady pull.

bloodlines.style: Long-sighted and deliberate - see in whatever living thing is in front of you what it inherited and what it will pass on.

boasting.style: Big, front-loaded and rhythmic - the claim first, the detail after, the doubt shouted down.

bonesetting.style: Firm, sure and unhurried - judge whatever is in front of you by feel, and what it needs to be set right.
bonesetting.reminder2: someone whose hands know at once what is out of place

branding.style: Plain and unsentimental - do what has to be done, counted and quick, without pretending it is gentle.

brawling.style: Scrappy and blunt, with a brawler's relish - judge whatever is in front of you by how it could be used in a fight.

brewcraft.style: Shrewd and patient - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it has been given its proper time.
brewcraft.reminder2: someone who judges by nose and by patience

bribery.style: Smooth and unspoken - see in whatever is in front of you what could be offered without saying so.

brute_force.style: Heavy, blunt and contemptuous of anything delicate - judge whatever is in front of you by what force would do to it.

burrowing.style: Low and close, comforted by enclosure - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it offers somewhere to go under.

bushcraft.style: Steady and at home - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it would keep you warm, dry and safe.

butchery.style: Calm, plain and unsqueamish - see whatever is in front of you for how it is put together.

byre_sense.style: Blunt and unsqueamish - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it is well kept or neglected.
byre_sense.reminder2: someone who can tell at once whether things are cared for

calligraphy.style: Fine and attentive - judge whatever is in front of you by its shape, its balance and the character of its making.

canecraft.style: Rhythmic and tireless - judge whatever is in front of you by the steady work it would take.

card_sharping.style: Calm-faced and quick - see in whatever is in front of you the game, the mark and the advantage.

carousal.style: Warm and convivial, with the sly clarity of the least drunk person present - judge everyone by how far gone they are.
carousal.reminder2: someone who always keeps a clearer head than they show

carrion_sense.reminder2: someone who knows death when they meet it, and how long ago it came

carting.style: Practical and steady - judge whatever is in front of you by the line through it and what would get stuck.

cartography.style: Restless and precise - fix whatever is in front of you in its right place relative to everything else.

cellarcraft.style: Careful and thrifty - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it will keep or spoil.

chandlery.style: Slow, patient and exact - judge things by the patience in them, well made or rank.

charnel_sense.style: Flat and unsqueamish - say what you sense plainly, and do not flinch or dwell.

childhood_reminescence.style: Wistful and faintly aching - let what is in front of you feel half-familiar, without naming any memory it does not hold.

civic_pride.style: Fond and proud - let whatever is in front of you gladden you as a part of the place you love.

clairvoyance.style: Hushed and expectant - sense in whatever is in front of you a meaning just beyond sight.

clambering.style: Light and confident, happiest above the ground - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it can be climbed.
clambering.reminder2: someone who sees every height as a way up

clerkship.style: Formal and correct - see everything in terms of form: who must agree, what makes it proper, what is still unofficial.

cobbling.style: Practical and observant - judge people by how they wear what they wear, and things by how well they are made.
cobbling.reminder2: someone who reads people by the wear on them

coin_eye.style: Quick and suspicious - check whatever is in front of you for whether it is what it claims to be.
coin_eye.reminder2: someone who checks everything before accepting it

cookery.style: Busy, practical and exact about timing - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it will be ready when it must.

coppicing.style: Patient and far-sighted - judge whatever is in front of you by what it will be years from now.

copying.style: Slow, even and exacting - attend to whatever is in front of you a little at a time, and catch the error.

brine_sense.style: Brisk and weathered - read whatever is around you by what the air brings, and how fresh it is.
